latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Discovery Call Opening Planner for B2B sales reps.

- Enables planning and scripting of the first 60–90 seconds of a discovery sales call using Rackham's evidence-based framework.
- Helps avoid two debunked opener patterns: personal rapport fishing and product/benefit dumping.
- Outputs a concise call-prep script and structural checkpoint review tailored to the call context (new, follow-up, senior executive, multi-stakeholder).
- Guides users on required input: account/contact details, call type, and call objective.
- Intended for use by sales professionals preparing or coaching for high-value B2B discovery calls.
